# Scanning Accelerator

> Football Accelerator by PB Coaching: personalised training plans that help players read the game faster, fix technique under pressure and stand out on the pitch.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Free personalised training plan based on your position.
- [Position Quiz](/quiz): 2-question quiz that maps you to a custom training plan.
- [Apply](/apply): Apply for a free discovery call with PB Coaching.
- [Live Training](/training): The Smart Player Blueprint live training with Patrick.
- [Scanning for Attackers](/scanning-attackers): 4-step scanning order for attackers.
- [Scanning for Midfielders](/scanning-midfielders): 4-step scanning order for midfielders.
- [Scanning for Defenders](/scanning-defenders): 4-step scanning order for defenders.
- [Technique for Attackers](/technique-attackers): First touch and finishing system for attackers.
- [Technique for Midfielders](/technique-midfielders): Receiving and passing under pressure for midfielders.
- [Technique for Defenders](/technique-defenders): Composure and build-up technique for defenders.
- [Conditioning](/conditioning): Match-day stamina system for footballers.

## Optional

- [8-Week Scanning Program](/offer/course): Self-paced course on scanning and decision-making.
